summary: 1 possible issue(s) found; verify each before acting.

findings.title: Repeated failed logins followed by success
findings.possible_threat: Repeated authentication failures may indicate a password-guessing attempt that eventually succeeded.
findings.rationale: 3 failures for user test1 from 192.0.2.10 within 68 seconds, then a success. Could also be the real user mistyping.
recommended_actions: Verify with the account owner that the successful login was theirs
Review other activity from this address
Consider a password reset and enabling MFA
findings.limitations: These events alone do not confirm an attack.
